pkgmetadata.longdescription: Inference engine written in Rust that reads GGUF files and stands in for llama-server, llama-cli, llama-bench and llama-quantize with their flags. Runs on the CPU, on NVIDIA GPUs through CUDA and on other GPUs through Vulkan; models larger than the GPU are split by layer or, for mixture-of-experts models, served from an expert cache. Speculative decoding is exact: the output equals plain decoding token for token.

use.flag: Build the CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs (needs nvcc at build time)
Build the Vulkan backend for AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs
